top_stories.title: National president Nabin asks BJP State unit not to be complacent while citing T.N. example of Opposition not benefitting from DMK’s failure - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Nitin Nabin**, **BJP** national president, warned the Karnataka unit to avoid complacency after the Tamil Nadu elections where the opposition AIADMK did not benefit despite anti-incumbency. He urged them to project themselves as a strong alternative and focus on public awareness against the Congress government's failures.  He also emphasized the need for a pro-people struggle and a comprehensive action plan for upcoming elections, including bypolls and Legislative Council elections. **Nabin** accused the Congress of using its government as an ATM to fund its national activities.

top_stories.title: MMK will continue its alliance with DMK, says Jawahirullah - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Manithaneya Makkal Katchi (MMK)** president M.H. Jawahirullah clarified that the party's recent resolution to contest on its own symbol was not due to disappointment over a lack of ministerial positions in the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam government. The MMK contested under the DMK’s ‘Rising Sun’ symbol in previous elections, and this decision was made based on ground realities and political circumstances.  The party's registration was cancelled after failing to contest on its own symbol, prompting the resolution for future elections.

top_stories.title: I wasn’t allowed to see her body, mother of murdered girl alleges - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: A grieving mother of a 10-year-old girl who was murdered and sexually assaulted near Coimbatore, alleged that her husband cremated the body without her consent. The woman claims she was given no opportunity to see her daughter's remains and demanded police action against her husband and relatives. **Minister for Transport A. Vijay Tamilan Parthiban** and **Minister for Backward Classes Welfare V. Sampath Kumar** visited the girl’s native place in Salem district and provided a relief assistance of ₹7 lakh to the family.

top_stories.title: Man held for chopping sandalwood tree in Tirupattur - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **K. Thangaraj**, a 42-year-old man from Jamunamarathur village, was arrested by **Tirupattur Taluk police** for chopping a sandalwood tree on the bund of a temple tank in Puthagaram village. The incident occurred around 7 a.m., when several devotees witnessed the act and apprehended **Thangaraj** while his accomplices fled.  The **Tirupattur Taluk police** and forest officials inspected the scene, registering a case and launching an investigation to apprehend the remaining suspects.

top_stories.title: Govt. plans to complete paddy procurement over next 10 days: Uttam Kumar Reddy - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **N. Uttam Kumar Reddy**, **Minister for Civil Supplies and Irrigation** of **Telangana**, warned rice millers against deducting weight from paddy brought by farmers during the current procurement season. He emphasized that the government is committed to ensuring no farmer suffers losses due to any discrepancies in weight deductions.  He also stated that despite facing operational and financial pressures, the government aims to procure 75 lakh tonnes of paddy within the next 10 days. The Minister highlighted the unprecedented agricultural output this Rabi season, urging officials to complete procurement operations swiftly.

top_stories.title: Trump says he does not make bad deals, but even Republican hawks doubt that now | US-Israel war on Iran | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Iran** and the **US** are close to a deal regarding Iran's nuclear program, but disagreements remain. The US has agreed to unfreeze billions of Iranian assets in exchange for restoring pre-war economic conditions, including reopening the Strait of Hormuz. However, both sides have expressed reservations about the concessions involved.  Iran insists on discussing its nuclear program within a 60-day timeframe and rejects language allowing Israel military operations in Lebanon. The future governance of the Strait of Hormuz remains uncertain as Iran and Oman discuss a Persian Gulf strait authority.

top_stories.title: BJP tried to stitch coalition govt. in Tamil Nadu with DMK and AIADMK on election result day: Congress MP Manickam Tagore - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **BJP** MP B. Manickam Tagore accused **DMK** leader Udhayanidhi Stalin of attempting to form a coalition government with the **AIADMK** to prevent TVK president C. Joseph Vijay from becoming Chief Minister.  He claimed that the **DMK**'s actions were orchestrated by the **BJP**, and that they will soon strike an understanding with the party, potentially leading to DMK MPs abstaining from voting against the BJP-led government in Parliament.  **Girish Chodankar**, Congress's in-charge for Tamil Nadu and Puducherry, responded to the accusations by stating that the attacks on the Congress should not be directed at the people of Tamil Nadu who voted.

top_stories.title: Riz Ahmed says UK spies tried to recruit him on three occasions | Riz Ahmed | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Riz Ahmed**, the Oscar-winning actor, has recounted three separate instances of alleged attempts by British intelligence services to recruit him. The incidents involved being questioned at Luton airport, through a family friend, and by a senior BBC executive. **Ahmed** described these encounters as "slightly ridiculous" and declined all offers.  He also expressed his desire to pursue stand-up comedy in the future.

top_stories.title: 'AI impact on Indians abroad is highest': How H-1B workers are struggling after Meta, Amazon layoffs - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Indian** tech workers in the US are facing significant challenges due to recent mass layoffs at companies like **Meta**, **Amazon**, and **Oracle**.  These layoffs have triggered a 60-day countdown for many, who must secure new jobs before their legal stay expires. The situation has sparked anxiety among Indian communities abroad, as families grapple with job loss, housing, and immigration deadlines. Some workers are attempting to switch to B-2 visitor visas in hopes of staying in the US while searching for employment.  The pressure is mounting alongside widespread layoffs across the tech industry.

top_stories.title: Fatou Bensouda on Israeli threats against her and the ICC | Israel-Palestine conflict | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Fatou Bensouda**, former chief prosecutor of the **International Criminal Court (ICC)**, has criticized the threats and pressure she faced while investigating Palestine. She argues that justice is being sacrificed to political interests, citing Israel's attempts to halt investigations and a lack of support from some ICC member states.  Bensouda also addresses US sanctions against the court and questions whether leaders like Israeli Prime Minister **Benjamin Netanyahu** can be held accountable by the ICC.
